scope: Whole named-model physical alias and protected path policy consumed by the mixed IDE edit transaction
evidenceNotes: focused-v6 has two actual passing executions (4258 physical and 5485 mixed assertions); its third files test failed before producer entry because the driver precreated the fixture directory. Raw overall receipt remains failed. Corrected files-v1 passed all 67 checks separately. focused-acceptance.json composes these actual records explicitly.
Production and public headers match frozen gui-source-v3 canonically; the final alias fixture is newer than that snapshot and is separately bound at focused-v6/tests and in all mutant receipts.
Initial attribute-only directory pins allowed actual MoveFile; final GENERIC_READ without delete sharing denies it without any body ReadFile. The rejected mutant reproduces the deficiency.

An initial fixture tried to modify a pinned name by atomic replacement. Corrected in-place writes verify that content is outside the identity policy. SDK control separately observed 8 then 1 new process handles followed by three stable replacements; this is an observation, not a claim about its underlying cause or the whole IDE resource profile.

Prior broad-v2 process handle was missing, process scan showed no live stage process, and the final receipt was absent. Its incomplete logs and exact verified aliases were retained/cleaned. A fresh broad-v3 run completed all 55 suites. An early launcher raced preparation, failed before starting validation, and is retained.
Native server and SDK are inherited exact accepted cohorts, not newly compiled in this stage. All 127 GUI production units were rebuilt together.
limits: The physical gate does not establish source content, full source closure, resolver candidates, request/connection/project/configuration validity, user consent or global write authority.
Only the dedicated recovery directory is a mandatory default exclusion. The complete transaction host must supply runtime/config/project/cache/protected paths explicitly.

All named models are copied on the UI; their bounded metadata is rechecked at Arm and Publish. Gate construction/identity validation run on the worker; no new normal keypress/startup call is added. No measured end-to-end latency/RSS/whole heap or hard realtime claim.
16MiB known gate storage plus 32KiB sorting scratch does not include allocator/kernel/OS resource costs. Direct failure probes do not intercept DLL-internal xarray growth.
Name handles and repeated checks are not a global filesystem transaction and do not exclude mapped writers or all external changes after the final worker check.
Complete transaction host/controller, remaining synchronous source readers, recovery UI/startup replay and standard rename/applyEdit activation remain open.
Whole-goal performance/resource/longevity, latest engine alignment and default final delivery remain open.
Existing compiler deep unprefixed xlp path limitation and analysis-configuration cache-count regression remain open.
C LSP stays disabled; no DAP/debug/runtime-object completion; no Linux/sanitizer qualification in this stage.
